sections.Description:
Since forming in 1981, Metallica has become one of the most influential and popular bands in musical history.

Metallica Remastered features an entirely new suite of presentation elements, including all video content and animations, new sound effects, and over 1,000 new speech calls that include callouts by the band.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- "Ride the Lightning”: Sparky's Electric Chair featuring an all-new custom sculpted, newly enhanced, articulated Sparky figure.
- "Master of Puppets": Grave Markers featuring a motorized, illuminated grave marker rising from the playfield with a ball magnet capable of catching and throwing the ball with special ball effects.
- "...And Justice For All": Disappearing magnetic ball mechanism holds pinballs while the all-new custom sculpted, motorized ball-smashing Gavel hits the ball into an underground Coffin subway lock.
sections.Editions:
Premium:
- Players can extend the fun with Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ system by accessing the iconic "Crank it Up" modes and "End of the Line" Wizard mode as Challenge Modes, all new achievements, and more!
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.
- Metallica Remastered is updated with a full-color LCD display featuring all-new animations, live concert video footage, new songs, and over 1,000 new speech calls including callouts by the band.

Limited Edition:
- Exclusive full color reflective foil Remastered side cabinet decals with hand-drawn artwork by renowned Metallica artist, Rhys Cooper.
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting System with Metallica "M" logo silhouette and Metallica-themed game effects.
- Limited Edition Remastered full color mirrored backglass with hand-drawn artwork by renowned Metallica artist, Rhys Cooper.
